name: Deeproot
description: Cannot be forced out of battle, and takes 10% less damage from Terra moves.

name: Thornskin
description: Contact moves cost the attacker 1/8 of its maximum HP.

name: Kindling
description: Flame moves deal 50% more damage below one third HP.

name: Short Fuse
description: Moves with a secondary effect trigger it twice as often.

name: Stillwater
description: Immune to confusion, and cures it on entry.

name: Riptide
description: Tide moves gain +1 priority in rain.

name: Close Quarters
description: Contact moves deal 20% more damage.

name: Deep Mind
description: Raises Special Defence one stage when hit by a Psyche move.

name: Quick Paw
description: Occasionally moves first regardless of Speed.

name: Scavenger
description: Recovers a consumed held item after battle.

name: Gritskin
description: Immune to sandstorm damage; Defence rises 30% in a sandstorm.

name: Keen Eye
description: Accuracy cannot be lowered.

name: Updraft
description: Speed rises one stage on entry in wind or storm weather.

name: Stormborn
description: Spark moves never miss in rain or storm.

name: Hardshell
description: Takes half damage from critical hits.

name: Swarming
description: Multi-hit moves always hit the maximum number of times.

name: Gripjaw
description: Trapping moves last two extra turns.

name: Thick Coat
description: Halves damage from Frost moves.

name: Forager
description: Finds an item after a battle it participated in.

name: Stonebound
description: Cannot be knocked back; Stone moves gain 20% power.

name: Ore-Dense
description: Halves damage from the first hit of every battle.

name: Static Cling
description: Contact moves have a 30% chance to paralyse the attacker.
